Description
The University of Liverpool is an elite university and a science and research powerhouse. The University was the original 'red brick' university, and its prestigious past is reflected in the present. It's a university with a fantastic reputation for research and science. Students on the foundation program will have access to truly excellent facilities at the University of Liverpool, including 2 main libraries: the Sydney Jones Library and the Harold Cohen Library. Foundation students can stay at the purpose-built student accommodation located in the same building as the University of Liverpool International College. Successful completion of the foundation program will lead to a choice of degrees at the University.
